meetings.location: Cincinnati Music Hall Ballroom, 1241 Elm St, Cincinnati, OH 45202
meetings.comment: 2026 Cincinnati Mayor and Council Inaugural Ceremony/City Council Session

items.t: Set Council committee members and meeting times
items.sm: Assigns Councilmembers to committees for the 2026-2028 term and sets when each committee meets.

items.t: Appoint the Council committee chairs
items.sm: Mayor Aftab Pureval appoints the chairs of the six Council committees, including Councilmember Jeff Cramerding for Budget, Finance and Governance.

items.t: Appoint Jan-Michele Lemon Kearney as Vice Mayor
items.sm: Mayor Aftab Pureval appoints Councilmember Jan-Michele Lemon Kearney as Vice Mayor, effective January 2, 2026.

items.t: Name Scotty Johnson President Pro Tem
items.sm: Names Councilmember Scotty Johnson President Pro Tem for the 2026-2028 term.

items.t: Appoint Anthony Covington as Clerk of Council
items.sm: Appoints Anthony Covington as Clerk of Council, starting January 6, 2026.

items.t: Adopt the Rules of Council and standing committees
items.sm: Readopts the previous Rules of Council and sets six standing committees for the term beginning January 6, 2026.

items.t: Certification of the 2026-2028 Council election
items.sm: Reports that the Hamilton County Board of Elections certified the election of the Councilmembers for the 2026-2028 term.

items.t: Successor Designation Certificates Received for 2026-2028 Council Term

items.t: Oath of Office for Mayor-Elect Aftab Pureval
items.sm: Administration of oath of office for Mayor-Elect Aftab Pureval for term ending 2030.

items.t: Oath of Office for Nine Councilmembers-Elect for 2026-2028 Term
items.sm: Administers oath of office to nine newly elected councilmembers beginning their 2026-2028 term.

items.t: 2026 City Council Inaugural Ceremony Notice
items.sm: Notice of 2026 City Council Inaugural Ceremony scheduled for January 6, 2026 at Music Hall Ballroom.

items.sm: Authorizes the sale of 0.1544 acres of City-owned land along Ridge Avenue in Oakley to East Main Design, LLC.

items.t: Approve the Clifton Neighborhood Plan
items.sm: Approves the Clifton Neighborhood Plan as the planning guide for the Clifton neighborhood.

items.t: Report from the Department of Finance for fiscal year 2026
items.sm: Presents the Department of Finance's unaudited report for the fiscal year that ended June 30, 2026.

items.t: Report on the fiscal year 2026 carryover
items.sm: Reports on carrying fiscal year 2026 funds over to fiscal year 2027.

items.t: Transfer General Fund surplus to reserves, housing and pensions
items.sm: Moves $2.9 million to the emergency reserve, $5 million for Cincinnati Development Fund housing, $2 million to the pension system and the rest to four other reserves.

items.t: Transfer $268,282 among capital improvement program accounts
items.sm: Closes out or reduces several capital project accounts and moves the $268,282 to other capital projects, as listed in the attached schedule.

items.t: Fund the replacement of the Neumann Clubhouse
items.sm: Creates a capital project and moves $5 million from the park improvement bond fund to replace the Neumann Clubhouse, including its equipment and furniture.

items.t: Apply for a $274,735 Justice Assistance Grant
items.sm: Authorizes the City to apply for a federal Justice Assistance Grant of up to $274,735 for police visibility overtime and the Women Helping Women sexual assault advocate contract.

items.t: Apply for an energy audit grant for City facilities
items.sm: Authorizes the City to apply for and accept up to $21,000 in technical assistance from the Ohio Department of Development to conduct energy audits of City facilities.

items.t: Amend the FC Cincinnati Foundation donation for Lincoln Recreation Center
items.sm: Amends Ordinance No. 355-2026 so the City can accept up to $178,293 in donated services from the FC Cincinnati Foundation to renovate the Lincoln Recreation Center mini-pitch.

items.t: Dedicate land for Evans Street and Police Academy Drive
items.sm: Accepts four small tracts of land in Lower Price Hill as public right-of-way for Evans Street and Police Academy Drive.

items.t: Sell 800 Evans Street to Nehemiah Manufacturing
items.sm: Authorizes the sale of City property at 800 Evans Street in Lower Price Hill to Nehemiah Manufacturing for a new $6.7 million manufacturing facility.

items.t: 800 Evans Street property tax exemption
items.sm: Approves a 15-year, 100 percent tax exemption on improvements for Nehemiah Manufacturing's new $6.7 million building at 800 Evans Street in Lower Price Hill.

items.t: Transfer $1.5 million for the CMHA City West rehabilitation
items.sm: Transfers $1.5 million from the Housing and Economic Development Capital Project Reserve to the Cincinnati Metropolitan Housing Authority's City West Housing Development Rehabilitation Project.

items.t: Authorize the transfer of $200,000 for three special events
items.sm: Transfers $200,000 from the special events reserve to provide $100,000 to the Black Family Reunion and $50,000 each to Asianati and Cincinnati Art Week 2027.

items.t: Replace Leveraged Support with direct funding and an arts fund
items.sm: Asks to move Leveraged Support funds into direct budget appropriations, the Human Services Fund and a new Vibrancy Art Fund for underserved communities.

items.t: Set Human Services Fund priorities for 2028-2029
items.sm: Amends Ordinance No. 36-2025 to split the fund 22% each for workforce, housing stability, violence reduction and youth, 10% for Access to Counsel and 2% for administration.

items.t: Fund Access to Counsel at a set share of the General Fund
items.sm: Asks for an ordinance funding the Access to Counsel Program at no less than 0.30% of the General Fund budget in fiscal years 2028 and 2029 and 0.35% after that.

items.t: Create a Vibrancy Art Fund for underserved neighborhoods
items.sm: Asks for an operating budget fund, led by Black Art Speaks with ArtsWave as fiscal agent, for artists and arts projects in underserved and LIFT neighborhoods, with yearly reports to Council.

items.t: Codify the uses of the Cannabis Revenues Restricted Fund
items.sm: Asks for an ordinance splitting cannabis revenue among home repair, new home ownership, ending childhood lead poisoning, child savings accounts and Youth to Work.

items.t: Allow carryover surplus to be used for operations
items.sm: Asks that the "Any Additional Surplus" carryover go 50% to the housing and economic development reserve and 50% to an unrestricted reserve instead of the infrastructure reserve.

items.t: Authorize a grant of up to $2,000,000 for the Midpointe Crossing Development in Bond Hill
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to apply for, accept and appropriate a grant of up to $2,000,000 from the Ohio Department of Development for the Midpointe Crossing Development in Bond Hill.

items.t: Pay $359.37 to Amazon Web Services for police cloud services
items.sm: Authorizes a payment of $359.37 to Amazon Web Services for cloud computing services used by the Cincinnati Police Department.

items.t: Sell City land on Ridge Avenue in Oakley
items.sm: Authorizes the sale of 0.1544 acres of City-owned land along Ridge Avenue in Oakley to East Main Design, LLC.

items.t: Presentation on the MetroRapid update
items.sm: Presents an update on MetroRapid, the bus rapid transit project.

items.t: Proceed with Option 2 for the Paul Clock Bell Tower
items.sm: Asks the Administration to proceed with Option 2 from the City's feasibility report: restore the Paul Clock Bell Tower and then transfer its ownership to the City.

items.t: Presentation on the rezoning of 5705 and 5711 Madison Road in Madisonville
items.sm: Presents the proposed rezoning of 5705 and 5711 Madison Road in Madisonville from T5N.SS-O and T4N.MF to Planned Development District No. 107.

items.t: Rezone 5707 and 5711 Madison Road for Veterans Village
items.sm: Rezones 5707 and 5711 Madison Road in Madisonville to Planned Development District No. 107, "Veterans Village."

items.t: Presentation on the proposed Clifton Neighborhood Plan
items.sm: Presents the resolution for the proposed Clifton Neighborhood Plan.

items.t: Approve the Clifton Neighborhood Plan
items.sm: Approves the Clifton Neighborhood Plan as the planning guide for the Clifton neighborhood.

items.t: Presentation on the Revive + Thrive home repair loan program
items.sm: Presents the City's Revive + Thrive home repair loan program.

items.t: 5051 Estecreek Road property tax exemption
items.sm: Exempts improvements at 5051 Estecreek Road in Winton Hills from property tax for 30 years under the development agreement with OH Cincinnati Estecreek, LLC for a cold storage facility.

items.t: Fund pedestrian safety improvements in Pleasant Ridge
items.sm: Creates a capital project and moves $1 million from the Pleasant Ridge TIF fund for pedestrian safety and traffic calming along Montgomery Road, Losantiville Avenue, Ridge Avenue and nearby streets.

items.t: Approve a job creation tax credit for AMEND Consulting
items.sm: Approves a tax credit equal to 45 percent of new City income tax revenue for AMEND Consulting, which will create at least 80 jobs at 312 Plum Street.
